tasks.goal: Start an encounter for a new patient with one study
tasks.doneCriterion: The chosen study form is open at /encounter/<id>/<studyType> with the typed patient name shown in the encounter banner
preconditions: none beyond the app being reachable — the walk starts a fresh encounter at / with patient name '[UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12] <task>'

tasks.goal: Start an encounter for a new patient with several studies
tasks.doneCriterion: The first selected study form is open and the encounter banner shows the patient name plus one chip per selected study (patient typed once, never asked again)
preconditions: none beyond the app being reachable — the walk starts a fresh encounter at / with patient name '[UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12] <task>'

tasks.goal: Start a right-leg-only venous study for a new patient
tasks.doneCriterion: A venous study form is open whose encounter banner chip / study type marks it right-leg-only (venousLERight), not bilateral
preconditions: none beyond the app being reachable — the walk starts a fresh encounter at / with patient name '[UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12] <task>'

tasks.goal: Switch to another study of the same patient
tasks.doneCriterion: The other study's form is open in the same encounter, banner shows the same patient name and no intake field is shown again
preconditions: an in-progress encounter exists in this browser profile (two studies selected, e.g. venous LE + iliac-pelvic venous); created through the intake by an earlier walk step or task, patient name tagged [UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12] — never a hardcoded encounter id

tasks.goal: Add a forgotten study to the patient's open encounter
tasks.doneCriterion: The added study's form is open, its chip appears in the encounter banner, and the patient name was not re-typed
preconditions: an in-progress encounter exists in this browser profile (one study selected, e.g. venous LE only); created through the intake by an earlier walk step or task, patient name tagged [UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12] — never a hardcoded encounter id

tasks.goal: Reopen an unfinished encounter after the browser was closed
tasks.doneCriterion: The study form is open again showing the findings entered before the reload (e.g. a segment previously marked incompetent still reads incompetent)
preconditions: an in-progress encounter exists in this browser profile (with at least one finding entered); created through the intake by an earlier walk step or task, patient name tagged [UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12] — never a hardcoded encounter id
the walker reloads the page before the task starts (entry navigate to /)

tasks.goal: Correct the patient's details in an open encounter
tasks.doneCriterion: The encounter banner shows the corrected patient name and the previously entered study findings are still present
preconditions: an in-progress encounter exists in this browser profile (with a deliberately misspelled patient name and at least one finding entered); created through the intake by an earlier walk step or task, patient name tagged [UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12] — never a hardcoded encounter id

tasks.goal: Remove an abandoned encounter from the in-progress list
tasks.doneCriterion: The discard confirmation dialog for the chosen encounter is open with its confirm button reachable and enabled
tasks.stopAtThreshold: Discard-confirm button in the in-progress list's discard ConfirmDialog (ongoing-visits-discard-<id> → confirm action) reachable+enabled — DO NOT CLICK
preconditions: an in-progress encounter exists in this browser profile (a throwaway encounter the walker itself created for this task); created through the intake by an earlier walk step or task, patient name tagged [UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12] — never a hardcoded encounter id

tasks.goal: Record a normal venous study of both legs
tasks.doneCriterion: Every segment row in both legs reads normal/competent, the anatomy diagram shows all segments in the normal colour, and the save status shows a last-saved time
preconditions: none beyond the app being reachable — the walk starts a fresh encounter at / with patient name '[UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12] <task>'

tasks.goal: Record great saphenous vein reflux with reflux time and CEAP class
tasks.doneCriterion: The GSV row of one leg reads incompetent with the reflux time in seconds, that segment is coloured incompetent on the anatomy diagram, and a CEAP clinical class is selected
preconditions: none beyond the app being reachable — the walk starts a fresh encounter at / with patient name '[UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12] <task>'

tasks.goal: Record a deep vein thrombosis in one leg
tasks.doneCriterion: The affected deep-vein row (e.g. femoral or popliteal) shows non-compressible / thrombosed and the anatomy diagram colours that segment as thrombosed
preconditions: none beyond the app being reachable — the walk starts a fresh encounter at / with patient name '[UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12] <task>'

tasks.goal: Record a normal arterial study with ankle-brachial index
tasks.doneCriterion: Segment rows read normal (triphasic) and the ABI badges for both legs show an auto-computed value in the normal band
preconditions: none beyond the app being reachable — the walk starts a fresh encounter at / with patient name '[UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12] <task>'

tasks.goal: Record a femoral artery stenosis with waveform and peak velocity
tasks.doneCriterion: The superficial femoral artery row of one leg shows the chosen waveform, the PSV value and a stenosis grade, and the segment is coloured abnormal on the anatomy diagram
preconditions: none beyond the app being reachable — the walk starts a fresh encounter at / with patient name '[UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12] <task>'

tasks.goal: Record a normal carotid study
tasks.doneCriterion: All carotid segment rows read normal and the NASCET panel shows the normal / <50% category for both ICAs
preconditions: none beyond the app being reachable — the walk starts a fresh encounter at / with patient name '[UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12] <task>'

tasks.goal: Enter internal carotid velocities and plaque and read the stenosis category
tasks.doneCriterion: With ICA PSV, EDV and plaque entered for one side, the NASCET panel shows the auto (SRU) category for that side
preconditions: none beyond the app being reachable — the walk starts a fresh encounter at / with patient name '[UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12] <task>'

tasks.goal: Record a normal iliac and pelvic venous study
tasks.doneCriterion: Every IVC / right / left row of the iliac-caval table reads patent and competent and the save status shows a last-saved time
preconditions: none beyond the app being reachable — the walk starts a fresh encounter at / with patient name '[UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12] <task>'

tasks.goal: Record left gonadal vein reflux with its diameter
tasks.doneCriterion: The left gonadal vein shows the entered diameter (mm) and reflux present, and the anatomy diagram reflects the finding
preconditions: none beyond the app being reachable — the walk starts a fresh encounter at / with patient name '[UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12] <task>'

tasks.goal: Draw a freehand mark on the anatomy diagram
tasks.doneCriterion: A freehand stroke is visible on the anatomy diagram and is still there after reopening the encounter from /
preconditions: an in-progress encounter exists in this browser profile (with a venous LE study selected); created through the intake by an earlier walk step or task, patient name tagged [UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12] — never a hardcoded encounter id

tasks.goal: Add a text label on the anatomy diagram
tasks.doneCriterion: A text label with the typed words is visible on the anatomy diagram and is still there after reopening the encounter from /
preconditions: an in-progress encounter exists in this browser profile (with a venous LE study selected); created through the intake by an earlier walk step or task, patient name tagged [UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12] — never a hardcoded encounter id

tasks.goal: Write the conclusion for a finished study
tasks.doneCriterion: The conclusion (impression) field holds the typed text and the save status shows a last-saved time; the text is still there after reopening from /
preconditions: an in-progress encounter exists in this browser profile (whose venous LE study already has findings entered); created through the intake by an earlier walk step or task, patient name tagged [UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12] — never a hardcoded encounter id

tasks.goal: Download the PDF report of a finished study
tasks.doneCriterion: A PDF file download event fires (filename venous-le-<patient>-<date>.pdf or the study's equivalent) and no PDF-failed error toast appears
preconditions: an in-progress encounter exists in this browser profile (single study, findings and conclusion complete); created through the intake by an earlier walk step or task, patient name tagged [UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12] — never a hardcoded encounter id

tasks.goal: Preview the PDF report before printing
tasks.doneCriterion: The PDF opens in a new browser tab showing the patient name and the study findings
preconditions: an in-progress encounter exists in this browser profile (single study, findings and conclusion complete); created through the intake by an earlier walk step or task, patient name tagged [UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12] — never a hardcoded encounter id

tasks.goal: Download one combined PDF for a patient with several studies
tasks.doneCriterion: One PDF file download event fires (filename encounter-<patient>-<date>.pdf) containing every study of the encounter, and no error toast appears
preconditions: an in-progress encounter exists in this browser profile (two studies, both with findings complete (unified export is disabled until every study is complete)); created through the intake by an earlier walk step or task, patient name tagged [UXWALK-angio-module-2026-11-12] — never a hardcoded encounter id
